text.en:
The Capiz High School in the City of Roxas is hereby converted into a national school to be
known as the Capiz National High School.

The Minister of Education and Culture is hereby empowered to reorganize said School
accordingly.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be
included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
